description: Bell County certified appraisal exports: 2026 tab-delimited extract (zip); 2025 and 2024 PACS exports (7z, rar). See docs/registry/sources/tx-bell-cad.md.

sources.publisher: Tax Appraisal District of Bell County
sources.license: Public record (Tex. Gov't Code ch. 552); no license, terms of use or disclaimer stated on the data portal
sources.redistribution: Not addressed by the publisher; public record
sources.notes: Data portal re-read 2026-11-12 by the collector's identified client: no terms, no click-through, no login; site footer is a copyright line only. robots.txt: WordPress default (Disallow /wp-admin/ only), no Content-Signal. The four configured files were checked by HEAD on 2026-11-12 (sizes and Last-Modified unchanged from the 2026-11-08 archive). The district changed systems in 2026: the 8.0.33 layout is labelled 'Files Created Prior to 5/1/2026' and the 2026 certified export is a tab-delimited extract with no published layout (adapter tx_bell). 2025 and 2024 are PACS exports loaded as value history only. Also on the page, not configured: 2025 export as of supplement 60 (.rar), 2024 export as of supplement 52 (.zip), condensed xlsx rolls, preliminary 2027, collections, mortgage export, shapefiles.
